component.name: OpenCMR2
component.summary: Native port of Colin McRae Rally 2.0

description.p: OpenCMR2 is a native open-source port of Colin McRae Rally 2.0 (PC, 2000) built on the CMR2Decomp decompilation. It runs the original game code natively on Linux with SDL3, Vulkan or OpenGL 3.3, without emulation or Wine.
No game assets are included. You need your own copy of the original PC version of Colin McRae Rally 2.0; on first launch, OpenCMR2 asks you to select your installation folder.

ul.li: Widescreen resolutions, configurable field of view, and high frame rates with original physics parity
Keyboard, gamepad, and steering wheel support with rumble and force feedback
Built-in Bink video playback and LAN/internet multiplayer over UDP
Sharpened UI icons, flags, maps, and outline text that scale cleanly on modern displays

screenshot.caption: Arcade race starting grid running natively on Linux in widescreen
Widescreen stage racing with scaled HUD and modern rendering

description.p: Add Linux desktop metadata, CMake install rules, portable AppImage builds, and Flatpak packaging.
